ValidationRule.description: Loss reason must be filled when the opportunity is closed lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Lost") && OR(ISPICKVAL(Loss_Reason__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Loss_Reason__c, 'Other') && ISBLANK( Loss_Reason_Description__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The loss reason and description must be provided
